notes.title: New game engine
notes.notes:
How's it going?! Over the last couple weeks I had a task to convert the game to the new version of the game engine.

The issue was that the game did not start on some machines due to the problem of shaders compiling.

This task has been completed successfully. However, if you still have any problems, just drop me a message!

- Alex

notes.title: A Puzzle Has Been Simplified
notes.notes:
Hey!

Quite a lot players get stuck when they reach the Frog riddle. Out-of-the-box nature of this puzzle may make someone demotivated, which results in negative gaming experience.

Balancing puzzles are always a tricky thing in any adventure game. Recently I gave some thought to this issue and made a decision to simplify the riddle by adding a dialogue hint and removing some redundant parts of the surrounding area. At the same time I left the out-of-the-box core of the puzzle.

If you still have any questions, can't get through some part of the game, you may contact me here, via Steam chat or send a letter to EFGamesHelp@gmail.com. I'll do my best to help you.

- Alex
